why: Elyoum barcha developers ye5dmou b AI coding tools kol nhar: Copilot fel IDE, Cursor, Claude Code fel terminal. El recruteurs fi Tounes w fi l'Europe wallew yes2lou 3lihom fel entretien. Ama el outil hedha ynajem y5allik te5dem asra3... walla y5allik tdakhel bugs w failles b sor3a. El course hedha y3allmek testa3mel el outils hedhom b tari9a professionnelle: context, plan, tests, review, sécurité, w kifech tet3allem bihom mouch bark tkopi.
outcome: Tfarra9 bin autocomplete, chat w agent w ta5tar el outil el monasseb, tekteb CLAUDE.md behi, t5addem agent b plan w diffs sghar, t7ot tests bech t7mi el code, ta3mel review l code ktbou AI, t7mi el secrets mte3ek, w tfasser el workflow mte3ek fel entretien.

lessons.title: El landscape: autocomplete, chat w agents
text: Ki n9oulou 'AI coding tools', rana nahkiw 3la 3 familles. El louela: el autocomplete (complétion). Tekteb fel IDE w el outil ye9tre7 el ster el jey walla function kamla b el gris, w inti tenzel Tab ken 3jbek. GitHub Copilot houwa elli 3ammem el fekra hedhi, w tawa barcha éditeurs 3andhom kifha. El autocomplete sri3 w ma y9ass3ech el flow mte3ek, ama ychouf ghir chwaya context: el fichier elli 7allou w chwaya fichiers 9rab.

El famille el theniya: el chat fel IDE. Tselectionni code w tes2el 'chnoua ya3mel hedha?' walla 'ekteb test l function hedhi', w el jweb yji fi panneau 3al jnab. Copilot Chat, Cursor (éditeur mabni 3la VS Code w el AI fi 9albou) w extensions o5rin ya3mlou hakka. Hedha behi bech tefhem code, tes2el 3la erreur, walla t7adher bout sghir. Ama inti elli tkopi, inti elli t5addem, w inti elli t9arrer.

El famille el theltha: el agents (agentic coding tools). Houni ma tes2elch 3la bout code: ta3ti mission ('zid pagination lel endpoint /orders w testiha'). El agent y9ra el repo, yfattech fel fichiers, ybaddel barcha fichiers, y5addem commandes (tests, linter, build), ychouf el natija w y3awed 7atta ykammel. Claude Code, el outil mta3 Anthropic, men el famille hedhi: tlanciih fel terminal (CLI), fel desktop app, fel web, walla 3abr extensions l IDE kima VS Code w JetBrains. Cursor w Copilot zeda zedou modes agent. Kima chefna fi course el Claude API, agent = model + tools + loop; houni el tools homa mta3 el developer: 9ra fichier, ekteb fichier, 5addem commande.

Wa9tech kol wa7ed? Autocomplete lel code elli inti ta3refou w t7eb tektbou asra3: boilerplate, tests chbih b ba3dhhom, mapping. Chat ki t7eb tefhem walla tes2el 3la bout precis. Agent ki el mission tmess barcha fichiers w lezemha t5addem commandes: refactoring, feature sghira m3a tests, migration, investigation mta3 bug. Ama el agent mouch magie: ki el mission ghamdha walla el repo ma fihech tests, ynajem yebni 7aja kbira w ghalta b thi9a kbira.

El 9a3da el 3amma: kol ma el outil ya5ou autonomie akther, kol ma lezmek context w contrôle akther. W ma tensech elli barcha 7ajet ma t7ebch AI: el rename w el refactor mta3 el IDE ma yghaltouch. Lel prix w el abonnements, chouf el pages officielles mta3 kol outil: yetbaddlou barcha, w el charika mte3ek ynajem ykoun 3andha choix deja (lesson 6).
points: Autocomplete: sri3, context sghir, inti tkammel w t9arrer.
Chat fel IDE: tefhem w tes2el; inti tkopi w t5addem.
Agent: y9ra, ybaddel w y5addem commandes wa7dou fi loop.
Autonomie akther = context, tests w review akther.

example.code:
Need                                   Best fit
-------------------------------------  ----------------------------------
Finish the line, boilerplate           Autocomplete (Copilot, Cursor...)
"What does this function do?"          Chat in the IDE
Fix a failing test across 4 files      Agent (Claude Code, agent modes)
Explore an unknown repository          Agent or chat, read-only first
Rename a variable in one file          The IDE's own refactor, no AI
example.note: Mouch kol 7aja t7eb AI: el refactor mta3 el IDE deterministe w ma yghaltch.

lessons.title: T5addem agent: context, plan, steps sghar w review
text: El agent ma ya3rafch el projet mte3ek kima inti. Ma ya3rafch 3lech el table hedhi fiha zouz colonnes date, walla chkoun yesta3mel el endpoint el 9dim. Ken ta3tih mission b jomla wa7da, y3abbi el fera8 b hypothèses. Lhné el 9a3da el louela: el context. 9ollou chnoua el hadaf (mouch bark el tâche), ena fichiers mouhemmin, chnoua el contraintes (ma tbaddelch el API publique, ma tzidch dépendance), w kifech ya3ref elli kammel (ena tests lezem ye5dmou).

El 9a3da el theniya: plan 9bal el code. Otlob menou y9ra w ye9tre7 plan, bla ma ybaddel chay. Fi Claude Code fama plan mode lel 7aja hedhi: el agent yfattech w y9ra bark, w y9addemlek plan ta9rah w tsalla7ou. Plan ghalet tsalla7ou fi d9i9a; 400 ster ghaltin tsalla7hom fi se3a. W ki ta9ra el plan, barcha marrat tektachef elli inti zeda ma kontech wadh7 fel 7aja elli t7ebha.

El 9a3da el theltha: steps sghar. Mission kbira ('3awed ekteb el module mta3 el paiement') 9assamha: awel 7aja el tests, ba3d el refactoring, ba3d el feature. Kol step = diff sghir ta9rah, tests t5addemhom, w commit. Ki step yo5rej ghalet, traja3 lel commit elli 9bal, mouch tfattech fi 30 fichier tbaddlou. Git houwa el ceinture de sécurité mte3ek: branch l kol mission, w commits sghar.

El 9a3da el rab3a: review l kol diff. El agent ynajem ybaddel 7aja ma tlabtehech: yfasa5 test 5ater yfachli, yzid try/except yebla3 el erreur, walla ybaddel fichier ma 3andou 7atta 3la9a. Claude Code y5allik tchouf el diff w yotlob permission 9bal ma ybaddel fichier walla y5addem commande (7asb el réglages mte3ek). Ma t9oulch 'yes' kol marra bla ma ta9ra: el 'yes' 3al 3ama hiya elli tdakhel el bugs.

W ki el agent yet5abbet (y3awed nafs el ghalta, walla el conversation twalet barcha), ma t5allihch ydour: wa99fou, 9ollou chnoua el ghalta, walla ebda session jdida b context ndhif w résumé sghir. El context window kbira ama mouch infinie, w conversation mliena b tentatives ghaltin t5alli el model yet5abbet akther.
points: Context: el hadaf, el fichiers, el contraintes w critère mta3 'kammel'.
Plan 9bal el code; plan mode ki ynajem.
Step sghir = diff sghir = review sahla = commit.
Ta9ra kol diff; ma t9oulch 'yes' 3al 3ama.
Ki yet5abbet: wa99fou, wadh7ou, walla session jdida.

example.code:
Goal: customers must be able to page through their orders
(the mobile app loads 2,000 orders at once today).

Task: add pagination to GET /orders in api/orders.py.
- Query params: page (default 1) and page_size (default 20, max 100).
- Keep the response backward compatible: add "page" and "total", do not rename fields.
- Do not add new dependencies.

Done when: the existing tests pass and new tests cover page 1,
the last page and page_size > 100.

First read the relevant files and propose a short plan.
Do not edit anything until I approve the plan.
example.note: El prompt fih el 3lech, el chnoua, el contraintes w el critère, w yotlob plan 9bal ay tabdil.

lessons.title: CLAUDE.md: el ta3limet mta3 el projet
text: Kol session jdida, el agent yebda mel sfer: ma yetfakkarch chnoua 9otlou el bera7. El 7al: fichier ta3limet y9rah wa7dou fel bdaya. Fi Claude Code, houwa CLAUDE.md: fichier markdown fel racine mta3 el repo, w Claude Code y7ottou fel context automatiquement fi kol session. Tnajem zeda t7ot CLAUDE.md fi sous-dossier (ta3limet 5assa b partie mel code), w wa7ed personnel fel dossier mta3 el user lel préférences mte3ek fel projets lkol. El commande /init t7adher awel version men el repo, w inti tsalla7ha.

Chnoua t7ot fih? Louel el commandes: kifech tinstalli, tlanci el tests, el linter, el build. Hedhi akther 7aja tnaf3ek: bla biha el agent y5ammen ('npm test? pytest? make?') w yedhya3 el wa9t. Theni el conventions: el style, el structure mta3 el dossiers, el libraries elli testa3melhom (w elli ma testa3melhomch), kifech tsammi el fichiers. Theleth el 9wa3ed: 'ma tmessech el migrations el 9dom', 'kol endpoint jdid lezmou test', 'ma tcommitich direct 3la main'.

Ekteb 9sir w precis. CLAUDE.md yod5el fel context fi kol session: kol ster yetkallef tokens w ya5ou chwaya mel attention mta3 el model. 'Ekteb code ndhif' ma tnaf3ech: el model ya3refha. 'Esta3mel httpx mouch requests' tnaf3. W ma t3abbich el fichier b 'IMPORTANT' fi kol ster: ki kol chay important, ma3adech 7atta chay important.

CLAUDE.md fichier 7ay. Ki tchouf el agent y3awed nafs el ghalta (yesta3mel library ghalta, yensa yactivi el venv), zid ster. Commitih fel repo bech el équipe lkol testafed, w a3mel review lel tabdilet mte3ou kima el code. W ma t7ot fih 7atta secret: el fichier fel Git, yet9ra men el équipe lkol w men el model.

El outils el o5rin 3andhom nafs el fekra b asami o5rin: Copilot y9ra fichier instructions mta3 el repo, Cursor 3andou rules mta3 el projet, w barcha outils wallew y9raw AGENTS.md. El esm yetbaddel, el principe nafsou: el ma3loumet elli el agent ma ynajemch y5ammenha, b ktiba 9sira w precise.
points: CLAUDE.md fel racine yet9ra fi kol session; /init y7adher awel version.
Commandes, conventions w 9wa3ed: el 7ajet elli el agent ma ynajemch y5ammenha.
9sir w precis: kol ster ya5ou blasa fel context.
Commitih, a3mellou review, zid 3lih ki ghalta tet3awed, w 7atta secret fih.

example.code:
# CLAUDE.md

## Project
Django API for a Tunisian delivery startup. Python 3.12, PostgreSQL.

## Commands
- Install: pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
- Run tests: pytest -q
- Lint and format: ruff check . && ruff format .
- Run locally: python manage.py runserver

## Conventions
- Business logic goes in services/, not in views.
- Use httpx for HTTP calls, not requests.
- Money is stored in millimes (integer), never as float.
- Every new endpoint needs tests in tests/api/.

## Rules
- Never edit existing files in migrations/; create a new migration.
- Never read or print .env files.
- Run pytest and ruff before saying a task is done.
example.note: El 7ajet hedhom el agent ma ynajemch y5ammenhom wa7dou: el millimes, httpx, el migrations.

lessons.title: El tests: el filet de sécurité mte3ek
text: Code ktbou AI ynajem ybén s7i7 w houwa ghalet. El review b 3inik tla99ef barcha, ama ma tla99efch kol chay: cas limites, arrondi, date fi fuseau horaire... El tests homa el dalil elli el code ya3mel chnoua t7eb, w zeda elli tabdil ghodwa ma kasser chay. M3a agent, el tests yzidou ahammiya: el agent ynajem y5addem el tests wa7dou, ychouf chnoua fachel w ysalla7, ken el tests mawjoudin w el commande mektouba fi CLAUDE.md.

Otlob el tests b dhabt. Mouch 'zid tests', ama: 'ekteb tests pytest l apply_discount: cas normal, code inconnu, code expiré, w arrondi lel millime'. Ba3d a9ra el tests 9bal el code: test ma ychouf chay ('assert result is not None') ma y7mi chay. Test behi ychouf natija precise.

TDD m3a AI: el ordre elli ye5dem mli7. (1) Inti (walla el agent) tekteb tests y9oulou chnoua t7eb. (2) T5addemhom w tchoufhom yfachiw: ken ma fachlouch, el test ma ychouf chay walla el feature deja mawjouda. (3) Commit lel tests. (4) T9oul lel agent: 'implémenti bech el tests ye5dmou, w ma tbaddelch el tests'. Hakka el tests ywalliw el spécification, w el agent 3andou critère wadh7 bech ya3ref elli kammel.

Ma t5allich el agent 'ysalla7' test b tabdil el test. Hedhi men akther el ghaltet: test yfachli, el agent ybaddel el assertion walla y7ot skip, w kol chay ywalli a5dhar. Ki ta9ra el diff, ay tabdil fi test kén mawjoud lezmou sbab wadh7. W zid: el tests elli yektebhom el agent l code elli ktbou houwa ynajmou y3awdou nafs el fehm el ghalet. Lhné test wa7ed 3al a9al lel cas el mouhem, ekteb-ou walla ra9bou b 3inik.

El CI (GitHub Actions walla ghirou) ykammel el 7kéya: kol pull request t5addem el tests, w ma tmergich code AI ma3addech 3al tests. W fel applications mta3 el AI (prompts, models), el tests yetsammew evals: hedhom fi course el evaluation (ai-evals).
points: El tests homa el dalil, mouch el impression mte3ek ki ta9ra el code.
Otlob cas precis, w a9ra el tests 9bal el code.
TDD: tests yfachiw, commit, ba3d implémentation bla tabdil el tests.
Test tbaddel walla t7at skip fi diff = alerte.

example.note: Ba3d el commit, el prompt: 'Implement apply_discount so these tests pass. Do not modify the tests.'

lessons.title: Review mta3 code AI: 3la chnoua tfattech
text: Code AI yo5rej ndhif, mrattab, b commentaires... w hedha elli y5allik tetheb fih akther mel lezem. El review mta3 code AI lezmha tkoun b nafs el sérieux (walla akther) mta3 review l code collègue. Fama 4 7ajet tfattech 3lihom dima.

Louel, el sécurité. Requête SQL b f-string (SQL injection), input mel user ma yetvalidech, fichier yet7all b chemin jey mel user, secret mektoub fel code, CORS mfattah lel kol, verify=False fi requête HTTPS bech 'temchi'. El model t3allem men code public, w el code public fih el ghaltet hedhom barcha. Kol endpoint, kol requête, kol 7aja tmess el auth: a9raha b 3inik.

Theni, el APIs elli ma mawjoudinch (hallucinated APIs). El model ynajem yesta3mel function ma mawjoudach fel library, paramètre men version o5ra, walla package b esm 9rib men esm s7i7. El 7ala el le5ra 5atra: ken package b el esm hedha mawjoud fi PyPI walla npm w ktbou 7add b niya 5ayba, tinstallih b yeddik. 9bal ma tzid dépendance: thabbet elli el package mawjoud, ma3rouf, w houwa elli t7ebbou. El tests w el linter yla99fou barcha functions ghaltin; el packages lezmhom 3inik.

Theleth, el licences. Bout code twil ynajem ykoun 9rib barcha men code mawjoud b licence (GPL mathalan). Fama outils fihom filtre lel 7ala hedhi, w el charikat 3andhom politiques. 9a3da 3amaliya: ma ta9belch bout code twil ma tefhmouch w ma ta3rafch men ena ja, w ki tzid library, chouf el licence mte3ha m3a el politique mta3 el charika.

Rabe3, el over-engineering. Tlabt function, jek module b 3 classes, interface, factory w config. Walla el agent zed error handling, retries w logs fi kol blasa. Code akther = bugs akther w review a9al. Es2el: 'chnoua el version el as8ar elli t3addi el tests?' W fasa5 el code el mayet, el fichiers elli ma 3andhom 7atta 3la9a, w el commentaires elli y3awdou el code. El 9a3da el 3amma: ken ma tnajemch tfasser kol ster fel diff, ma tmergihch.
points: Sécurité: SQL, input, auth, secrets, TLS: a9ra b 3inik.
Thabbet mel functions w el packages 9bal ma tinstalli.
Licences: bout twil ma tefhmouch = la.
El solution el as8ar elli t3addi el tests; ma tmergich ster ma tnajemch tfasrou.

example.code:
--- a/api/orders.py
+++ b/api/orders.py
@@ -12,2 +12,3 @@ def search_orders(db, customer_name):
-    query = f"SELECT * FROM orders WHERE customer_name = '{customer_name}'"
-    return db.execute(query).fetchall()
+    # Parameterized query: the driver escapes the value (no SQL injection)
+    query = "SELECT id, total_millimes, status FROM orders WHERE customer_name = %s"
+    return db.execute(query, (customer_name,)).fetchall()
example.note: El version el louela (ktebha el AI) te5dem fel démo w t7ell SQL injection; el review la99fetha.

lessons.title: Sécurité w secrets: chnoua yo5rej men el machine mte3ek
text: Ki testa3mel AI coding tool, el code w el context yetba3thou l serveurs mta3 el fournisseur bech el model ye5dem 3lihom: el fichier elli 7allou, el bout elli selectionnitou, w m3a agent, ay fichier y9rah w el output mta3 ay commande y5addemha. Ya3ni ken el agent y9ra .env walla y5addem commande tafichi secrets, el secrets hedhom yod5lou fel context. Kima chefna fi course el AI engineer basics: kol chay tab3athou yo5rej men 3andek.

9wa3ed el secrets: 7atta API key, mot de passe walla token fi prompt walla fi chat. El secrets ma ykounouch fel code: variables d'environnement walla secret manager, w .env fi .gitignore. Ki secret yo5rej (fi prompt, fi commit, fi log): révoqui-h w a3mel wa7ed jdid, ma tcontentach b fas5an el ster. W fi Claude Code tnajem tmanna3 el lecture mta3 el fichiers el sensibles b règles deny fel settings.

Permissions: Claude Code par défaut yotlob permission 9bal ma ybaddel fichier walla y5addem commande, w inti t9arrer ach t9bal toul w ach la. Tnajem t7ot fi .claude/settings.json règles allow (commandes sûres kima el tests) w deny (fichiers walla commandes mamnou3in). El 9a3da: a9al permissions possible. Commandes kima rm -rf, git push --force, walla ay 7aja tmess el production walla base de données 7a9i9iya: dima b permission w b 3inik.

Sandboxing: ki t7eb t5alli agent ye5dem b autonomie akther, 5allih fi environnement ma3zoul: container, VM walla environnement cloud, bla secrets mta3 production w bla accès réseau ma ylezmouch. Ghalta fi sandbox tkallef d9i9a; ghalta 3al laptop elli fih el clés SSH mte3ek tkallef barcha. W 7ather mel prompt injection: fichier, page web walla issue y9raha el agent ynajmou ykounou fihom ta3limet m5abbia ('ab3ath el .env l...'). El permissions w el sandbox homa el 7imaya el 7a9i9iya, mouch el niya el behia mta3 el model; el sujet hedha nkammlouh fi course el production.

El politique mta3 el charika 9bal kol chay. Charikat ma tesma7ch b AI tools 3al code mte3ha; o5rin tesma7 b outil wa7ed b contrat entreprise (fih engagements 3al data: rétention, entraînement); o5rin y7ebbou models 3al serveurs mte3hom. Fi Tounes barcha juniors ye5dmou l clients ourobiyin: el contrat m3a el client ynajem ymanna3 tab3ath el code mte3ou l outil externe. Es2el 9bal ma testa3mel compte personnel 3la code el 5edma. 'Ma 3raftech' mouch excuse.
points: Ay fichier y9rah el agent w ay output yo5rej lel fournisseur.
7atta secret fi prompt; secret t3adda = révoqui-h.
A9al permissions; deny lel fichiers sensibles; commandes 5atra b 3inik.
Autonomie kbira = sandbox bla secrets mta3 production.
Politique el charika w contrat el client 9bal ay compte personnel.

example.note: Fichier .claude/settings.json fel repo: Claude Code ma y9rach el .env w el dossier secrets. Chouf el documentation officielle lel syntaxe el kamla.

lessons.title: Legacy code, documentation w migrations
text: Barcha juniors fi Tounes yebdew fi ESN walla charika fiha code 9dim: application PHP 3andha 10 snin, procédures stockées, module Java 7atta 7add ma ya3ref chkoun ktbou. Houni el AI tools ynaf3ou barcha, 5ater el 5edma el kbira hiya el 9raya, mouch el ktiba. Agent ynajem yfattech fel repo lkol, yetba3 el appels, w yfasserlek chnoua ysir ki el client y3addi commande.

Ebda b el 9raya bark (read-only). Es2el: 'Fasserli el flow mta3 el paiement mel controller lel base de données, w a3tini asami el fichiers w el functions.' W thabbet: 7ell el fichiers elli 9allek 3lihom. El agent ynajem yghlot fel ta7lil kima fel code: function b nafs el esm fi zouz blayes, config tbaddel el comportement... Tafsir el agent hypothèse, mouch vérité.

Documentation: el AI behi fi ktibet docstrings, README, schémas mta3 el architecture (b texte walla Mermaid) w notes d'onboarding. Ama doc ghalta a5yeb men bla doc. Ra9eb kol 7aja, w 5ousousan el '3lech' (3lech el code mektoub hakka): hedha el model ma ynajemch ya3rfou ken ma mektoubch fi blasa. Es2el el équipe w zid el 3lech b yeddik.

Migrations (Python 2 l 3, AngularJS l Angular, Java 8 l 17, upgrade mta3 framework): el tari9a elli te5dem: (1) tests 3al comportement el 7ali 9bal ay tabdil (characterization tests: ychoufou chnoua ya3mel el code tawa, 7atta ken fih bug); (2) plan b étapes sghar; (3) migration module b module, kol step tests a5dhar w commit; (4) review ki el agent yesta3mel API jdida: houni blaset el hallucinations, 5ater el model ynajem y5allet bin versions.

Hedha ybén twil, ama yemchi mli7 m3a agent: el agent ynajem yekteb el characterization tests, w inti tverifi elli homa y3aksou el comportement el 7a9i9i. W fi kol étape, el diff yob9a sghir w yet9ra. Hakka el migration elli kenet 'projet ta3 6 chhor ma 7add y7eb ymessou' twalli steps sghar tnajem t9addemhom fel sprint.
points: Legacy: el AI ynaf3 akther fel 9raya w el fehm.
Ebda read-only; tafsir el agent hypothèse lezem tverifiha.
Doc ghalta a5yeb men bla doc; el '3lech' ya3tih el insen.
Migration: characterization tests, plan, module b module, commit kol step.

Read-only task: do not edit any file.

Explain how an order is paid in this repository:
1. Entry point (route or controller) and the main functions called, in order.
2. Where the payment status is written to the database.
3. Anything surprising: duplicated logic, dead code, hard-coded values.

For each point, give the file path and function name so I can check it myself.

lessons.title: El carrière mte3ek: tet3allem b el AI, mouch tkopi bark
text: El 5atar el kbir 3al junior mouch elli el AI ya5ou blastou: houwa elli ywalli ma ya3refch ye5dem ken b el AI, w ma yefhemch el code elli ymergih. Fel entretien, fel debugging ki el production ta7et, walla ki el outil ghlet, el fehm mte3ek houwa elli yfarra9. Recruteur ynajem yes2lek 3la ster fi projet mel portfolio mte3ek: ken ma tnajemch tfasrou, el projet ywalli dheddek.

Kifech tet3allem bih: es2el '3lech' mouch bark 'kifech'. Ki el agent ysalla7 bug, otlob menou yfasser el cause. 7awel inti 9bal (15-20 d9i9a), ba3d 9aren m3a el 7al mta3 el AI. Otlob menou review l code mte3ek fi blaset ma yektbou houwa. Ekteb wa7dek marrat (kata, exercice) bla AI, kima el sportif elli yetmarran bla machine. W ki yesta3mel 7aja ma ta3refhech (decorator, generator, index SQL), a9ra el documentation officielle.

Ekteb journal sghir: kol semaine, 3 7ajet t3allemthom men sessions el AI (bug, pattern, commande). Hedha ynaf3ek fel fehm w fel entretien zeda. W fel projets mte3ek walla fel open source, el commits w el descriptions mta3 el PR lezem ykounou mektoubin b fehm: chnoua baddelt w 3lech, mouch résumé générique ktbou el AI.

Fel entretien: kon sincère. Barcha charikat tawa yes2lou 'testa3mel AI tools? kifech?'. El jweb el behi mouch 'la, 3omri' w mouch 'el AI yekteb kol chay'. El jweb el behi: workflow wadh7 (context w CLAUDE.md, plan, steps sghar, tests, review, sécurité) w mithel 7a9i9i: 'el agent 9tara7 package ma mawjoudech, la99eftou fel review'. Fama charikat ya3mlou exercices live bla AI, w o5rin m3a AI: 7adher rou7ek lel zouz.

exercises.answer:
Goal: users of our Flask app must log in with e-mail and password
before they can see /dashboard.

Context: users are in the users table (models/user.py); passwords are not stored yet.
Constraints:
- Hash passwords with werkzeug.security (already installed); no new dependencies.
- Do not change existing routes other than /dashboard.
- Never log passwords.

Done when: pytest passes, with new tests for a correct login, a wrong password
and /dashboard without login (redirect to /login).

exercises.q: Ekteb CLAUDE.md 9sir l projet FastAPI: Python 3.12, tests b pytest fi tests/, lint b ruff, migrations b Alembic (ma tmessech el migrations el 9dom), el dates dima UTC, w el agent ma y9rach .env.
exercises.hint: 3 sections: Commands, Conventions, Rules. 9sir w precis.
exercises.answer:
# CLAUDE.md

## Commands
- Run tests: pytest -q
- Lint and format: ruff check . && ruff format .
- New migration: alembic revision --autogenerate -m "<message>"

## Conventions
- Python 3.12, FastAPI.
- Store and compare dates in UTC; convert only for display.
- Tests live in tests/, one file per router.

## Rules
- Never edit existing files in alembic/versions/; always create a new migration.
- Never read or print .env files.
- Run pytest and ruff before saying a task is done.

exercises.q: Bech t5addem TDD m3a agent, ekteb el tests 9bal el code l function normalize_phone(text) traja3 numéro tounsi b format +216XXXXXXXX: '22 123 456', '+216 98 765 432', '00216 55 000 111', w numéro 9sir lezem ya3mel ValueError.
exercises.hint: Test l kol cas, w pytest.raises lel cas el ghalet.

exercises.q: El agent 3tak code fih: requests.get(url, verify=False), import 'fastjsonx' (library ma sma3tech biha), w classe ConfigFactory l function te9ra variable wa7da. Chnoua t9oul fel review?
exercises.answer: 1) verify=False ysakker el vérification mta3 el certificat TLS: 7add ynajem y9ra walla ybaddel el trafic. Fasa5ha; ken el certificat interne, esta3mel el CA mte3ou. 2) fastjsonx: thabbet elli el package mawjoud, ma3rouf w houwa elli t7ebbou; barcha marrat esm m5ammen walla 9rib men package s7i7, w 7add ynajem ykoun 7att package 5ayeb b el esm hedha. Ken json mta3 Python yekfi, esta3mlou. 3) ConfigFactory: over-engineering; os.environ.get fi function wa7da yekfi. Otlob el version el as8ar elli t3addi el tests.

exercises.q: Test 9dim yfachli ba3d tabdil 3amlou el agent. Fel diff tchouf elli el agent baddel el assertion men == 45_000 l == 44_999. Chnoua ta3mel?
exercises.answer: Ma ta9belch el tabdil. El test kén y5addem 9bal: ya3ni el code el jdid baddel el comportement, mouch el test elli ghalet. Traja3 el test kima kén, w t9oul lel agent: 'This test was passing before your change. Fix the code, do not modify the test, and explain what changed the result.' Ken ba3d el ta7lil el test houwa elli ghalet fe3lan (règle métier tbaddlet), tbaddlou inti b sbab mektoub fel commit, ba3d ma tthabbet m3a el équipe.

exercises.q: B el ghalta, 7att API key mta3 production fi chat m3a AI coding tool bech 'yfasserlek erreur'. Chnoua el étapes?
exercises.answer: 1) Révoqui el key toul fel console mta3 el fournisseur w a3mel wa7da jdida; el fas5an mel chat ma yekfich, 5ater el key 5rajet men el machine mte3ek. 2) Baddel el key fi el blayes elli testa3melha (secret manager, variables d'environnement). 3) Chouf el logs mta3 el usage ken fama usage ghrib. 4) 9oul lel responsable walla el équipe sécurité kima tetlob el politique. 5) Ba3d, zid règle deny lel .env w esta3mel placeholders kima <API_KEY> ki t7ot erreur fel chat.

pitfalls: Ta9bel kol diff b 'yes' bla ma ta9ra: el agent ynajem yfasa5 test, yebla3 erreur walla ybaddel fichier ma 3andou 7atta 3la9a.
Ta3ti mission kbira w ghamdha b jomla wa7da: el agent y3abbi el fera8 b hypothèses w yebni 7aja kbira w ghalta. Context, plan, w steps sghar.
T5alli el agent 'ysalla7' test b tabdil el assertion walla b skip: el CI ywalli a5dhar w el bug yob9a.
Tinstalli package 9tar7ou el AI bla ma tthabbet elli mawjoud w ma3rouf: ynajem ykoun m5ammen walla 5ayeb.
T7ot API key, mot de passe walla data mta3 client fi prompt, walla t5alli el agent y9ra .env: kol chay fel context yo5rej lel fournisseur.
Testa3mel compte AI personnel 3la code el charika walla el client bla ma tes2el 3al politique w el contrat.
Tmergi code ma tnajemch tfasrou: fel entretien walla fel incident, houwa elli yfadh7ek.

interview.q: Kifech testa3mel el AI coding tools fel 5edma mte3ek?
interview.a: Autocomplete lel code répétitif, chat bech nefhem code walla erreur, w agent kima Claude Code lel tabdilet elli tmess barcha fichiers. M3a el agent: context wadh7 w CLAUDE.md, plan 9bal el code, steps sghar b commit, tests, w review l kol diff 9bal el merge. W 3andi mithel 7a9i9i: la99eft fel review package ma mawjoudech 9tar7ou el agent.

interview.q: Chnoua el far9 bin autocomplete, chat w agent?
interview.a: El autocomplete ye9tre7 el ster el jey b context sghir w inti tkammel. El chat yjaweb 3la so2el 3la code selectionné, w inti tkopi w t5addem. El agent ya5ou mission, y9ra el repo, ybaddel barcha fichiers w y5addem commandes fi loop 7atta ykammel. Kol ma el autonomie tzid, el context, el tests w el review lezem yzidou.

interview.q: Chnoua t7ot fi CLAUDE.md walla fichier instructions mta3 projet?
interview.a: El 7ajet elli el agent ma ynajemch y5ammenha: el commandes (install, tests, lint, build), el conventions (structure, libraries, naming) w el 9wa3ed (ma tmessech el migrations el 9dom, test l kol endpoint). 9sir w precis 5ater yet9ra fi kol session w ya5ou blasa fel context. Commité fel repo, review kima el code, w 7atta secret fih.

interview.q: Kifech ta3ref elli code ktbou AI s7i7?
interview.a: Mouch b el impression. Tests 9bal el code (TDD) walla 3al a9al tests lel cas el mouhemmin, el CI t5addemhom 3la kol PR, w review b 3ini: sécurité, APIs w packages mawjoudin, licences, w over-engineering. W nraddou bali ken el agent baddel walla skippa test: hedhi alerte.

interview.q: Chnoua el risques mta3 sécurité ki testa3mel agent 3la el repo?
interview.a: El code w ay fichier y9rah w ay output yo5rej lel fournisseur, ya3ni secrets ynajmou yod5lou fel context. El agent ynajem y5addem commandes 5atra, w ynajem y9ra contenu fih prompt injection. El 7imaya: secrets fi variables d'environnement, deny 3al .env, a9al permissions, commandes 5atra b 3ini, sandbox ki autonomie kbira, w el politique mta3 el charika.

interview.q: Kifech testa3mel el AI 3la legacy code walla migration?
interview.a: Nebda read-only: notlob tafsir lel flow b asami el fichiers w el functions w nverifi b roh-i. Ba3d characterization tests 3al comportement el 7ali, plan b étapes, migration module b module b commit w tests l kol step, w review mezyena 3al APIs el jdod 5ater el model ynajem y5allet bin versions.

interview.q: El AI tools mouch yna99sou el besoin lel juniors? Kifech tet3allem m3ahom?
interview.a: Ybadlou chnoua yetlob men el junior: akther review, tests w fehm, a9al ktiba bel yedd. Ena nesta3mlhom bech net3allem: n7awel 9bal w na9aren, notlob tafsir w review, ne9ra el documentation ki tod5el 7aja jdida, w nekteb journal b chnoua t3allemt. W ma nmergich ster ma nnajemch nfasrou.
